fields.summary: TC-LCO-022: LCO Decision Matrix - Flight Number Change - Originals - Involuntary

content.text: Linked Story: LCO Decision Matrix

Precondition: Crew member is assigned as original crew on COA flight 123 HOU-DAL. Change type is Involuntary. Only the flight number changes - all planned values (origin, destination, dep/arr times) remain the same. isOriginal = TRUE.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a crew member with original assignment on COA flight 123 HOU-DAL
COA Flight 123 HOU-DAL, isOriginal=TRUE, changeType=Involuntary
Crew member is set up as original crew on COA flight 123 HOU-DAL
Apply an involuntary flight number change - same route HOU-DAL and same planned times but flight number changes from 123 to 234 by scheduler
Flight number change from 123 to 234, route HOU-DAL unchanged, times unchanged, changeType=Involuntary
Flight number change is applied successfully with only the flight number modified
Navigate to COA Search App and retrieve the COA record for the crew member
COA Search App - search by crew ID and trip
COA record is retrieved successfully
Verify the COA Flight retains the original flight number 123 HOU-DAL
COA Flight field in COA record
COA Flight: 123 HOU-DAL is present (original flight number retained)
Verify the Actual Flight reflects the new flight number 234 HOU-DAL on the same route
Actual Flight field in COA record
Actual Flight: 234 HOU-DAL is present (new flight number on same route)
Verify LCO eligibility status is not applicable for this flight number change scenario
LCO field in COA record
LCO: Not Applicable. Flight number change only does not trigger LCO.
